author: Diego Sandoval
title: Dean Wade agrees to 4-year, $39 million deal with Philadelphia 76ers
desc: Dean Wade has agreed to a 4-year, $39 million contract with the Philadelphia 76ers.
impact: Wade is coming off a season in which he averaged 22.3 minutes a game in the regular season and played a key role in Cleveland's run to the Eastern Conference Finals. The 29-year-old will give Philadelphia a strong defender and shooting option on the wing.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Zach Collins signs 2-year extension with Chicago Bulls
desc: Zach Collins signed a 2-year, $17 million contract extension to stay with the Chicago Bulls.
impact: Collins is entering his ninth NBA season after missing the vast majority of the 2025-26 campaign with an injury. Despite playing in just 10 games last season, he will look to carve out a bench role with the Bulls for the upcoming year.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Luke Kennard signs 2-year, $13 million deal with Phoenix Suns
desc: Luke Kennard has agreed to a 2-year, $13 million contract with the Phoenix Suns.
impact: Kennard is coming off a season with the Hawks and Lakers in which he led the league in three-point shooting at 47.8%. The 30-year-old will now join a Phoenix team to provide spacing for the backcourt duo of Devin Booker and Jalen Green.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Keon Ellis signs 2-year, $18 million contract with Brooklyn Nets
desc: Keon Ellis has signed a 2-year, $18 million contract with the Brooklyn Nets.
impact: Ellis will join the Nets after splitting the 2025-26 season with the Sacramento Kings and Cleveland Cavaliers. The 26-year-old averaged 8.3 points in 29 games with Cleveland down the stretch and now joins a rebuilding Nets squad.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kobe Sanders signs 4-year contract with Los Angeles Clippers
desc: Kobe Sanders has signed a 4-year, $11.2 million contract to return to the Los Angeles Clippers.
impact: Sanders is coming off a rookie season in which he averaged 7.3 points in 68 games played with LA. He will now have a chance to grow into a larger role on a new-look Clippers team after Kawhi Leonard was traded to Toronto.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Branden Carlson signs 1-year deal with Portland Trail Blazers
desc: Branden Carlson has signed a 1-year, $2.5 million contract with the Portland Trail Blazers.
impact: Carlson has spent the last two seasons with the Thunder, where he played just 9.9 minutes per game across 74 appearances. The 7-footer will look to develop into a bench piece for Portland next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Leonard Miller has contract fully guaranteed by Bulls
desc: The Chicago Bulls will fully guarantee the $2.41 million salary of Leonard Miller for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Miller had his team option exercised by the Bulls. He averaged 11.7 points on 55.5 percent shooting from the field with 5.8 rebounds in 27 games last season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kam Jones to be waived by Bulls
desc: The Chicago Bulls plan to waive Kam Jones.
impact: Jones had a deadline on Tuesday that would've fully guaranteed his salary at $2.15 million. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bones Hyland to return to Timberwolves
desc: Bones Hyland has agreed to return to the Minnesota Timberwolves next season.
impact: Hyland earned a larger role late last season into the playoffs. He'll figure to remain in a similar role heading into next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tim Hardaway Jr. to sign with Heat
desc: Tim Hardaway Jr. will be signing with the Miami Heat.
impact: Hardaway will add more shooting for a Miami roster built around Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: DeAndre Jordan agrees to deal with Pelicans
desc: DeAndre Jordan has agreed to a contract with the New Orleans Pelicans.
impact: Jordan will be back for his 19th NBA season and his second in New Orleans. The veteran played in just 12 games during the 2025-26 campaign and will likely remain a depth piece for the Pelicans.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ousmane Dieng signs 3-year, $17.5 million deal with Bucks
desc: Ousmane Dieng has signed a 3-year, $17.5 million contract to return to the Milwaukee Bucks.
impact: Dieng was traded to the Bucks midseason, averaging 11 points, 4.6 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 30 games with the team. He will return to a new-look Milwaukee squad that now features Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kel'el Ware following the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Quentin Grimes linked to Lakers
desc: Quentin Grimes is emerging as a top free agent target for the Lakers.
impact: The Lakers have plenty of money opened up with LeBron James not returning. They'll be looking to add more shooting around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dennis Schroder could be traded
desc: The Cavs have reportedly held trade conversations regarding Dennis Schroder.
impact: Schroder and Max Strus both could potentially be traded as Cleveland looks to free up space to try to bring back LeBron James.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Strus could be traded
desc: The Cavs have reportedly held trade conversations regarding Max Strus.
impact: Strus and Dennis Schroder both could potentially be traded as Cleveland looks to free up space to try to bring back LeBron James.
